summary_en: This note presents the Silverman-Toeplitz theorem for weighted averages of convergent sequences, gives a proof via splitting estimates, and develops a useful generalization with weaker normalization assumptions. It also includes applications and a counterexample showing the necessity of uniform absolute summability.

problems.statement_en: Silverman-Toeplitz theorem (1913): Let \(a_{n,k}\) be a nonnegative double sequence such that (1) \(\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1\) for every \(n\), and (2) for each fixed \(k\), \(\lim_{n\to\infty} a_{n,k}=0\). Then for every convergent sequence \(x_n\), one has \(\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n\).
problems.statement_zh: Silverman-Toepliz定理,1913：\(a_{n,k}\)是一个非负的双重序列，并且满足：1. 关于\(k\)的和为1，即\(\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1\)；2. 当\(k\)固定的时候，\(\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n,k}=0\)。那么对于任意的有极限的序列\(x_n\)，都有\(\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n\)。
key_techniques: limit reduction by subtracting the limit

problems.statement_en: Proposition 2.1 (generalization of the Silverman-Toeplitz theorem): Let \(a_{n,k}\) be a double sequence such that (1) \(\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1\), (2) for each fixed \(k\), \(\lim_{n\to\infty} a_{n,k}=0\), and (3) \(\sup_{n\in\mathbb N^+}\sum_{k\le n}|a_{n,k}|<+\infty\). Then for every convergent sequence \(x_n\), one has \(\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n\).
problems.statement_zh: 命题2.1:Silverman-Toepliz定理的推广：\(a_{n,k}\)是一个双重序列，并且满足：1. 关于\(k\)的和渐进为1，即\(\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^na_{n,k}=1\)；2. 当\(k\)固定的时候，\(\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n,k}=0\)；3. \(\sup_{n\in \mathbb{N}^{+}}\sum_{k\leq n}|a_{n,k}|<+\infty\)。那么对于任意的有极限的序列\(x_n\)，都有\(\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n\)。

problems.statement_en: Example 2.3 (counterexample after removing condition 3): Define \(a_{n,k}\) by \(a_{1,1}=1\), \(a_{n,n}=n\), \(a_{n,n-1}=1-n\), and \(a_{n,k}=0\) otherwise. Let \(x_k=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}\). Then \(\sum_{k\le n} a_{n,k}x_k = 2(-1)^n\), so the limit does not exist, showing that condition 3 in Proposition 2.1 is necessary.
problems.statement_zh: 例子2.3:去掉条件3之后的反例：令\(a_{n,k}:=\begin{cases}1&(n,k)=(1,1)\\n&(n,k)=(n,n)\\1-n&(n,k)=(n,n-1)\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}\)。令\(x_k:=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}\)，那么\(\sum_{k\leq n} a_{n,k}x_k = a_{n,n-1}x_{n-1}+a_{n,n}x_{n}=2(-1)^n\)这个和的极限不存在，更不会等于\(x_k\)的极限0。

key_techniques_discussed: uniform absolute summability of coefficient rows
